The observation describes the instant the request is made. Old held buttons continue during the estimated response delay. Derived forecasts are predictions, not future observations. Use the recorded stage mechanics, geometry, questions, history and shot feedback.
Choose movement and A control together, then choose throwing for the resulting facing. Neutral movement keeps the observed facing. release_a releases A; hold_a holds A. Holding A does not guarantee a new jump. Only fresh A/B presses trigger jumps/throws. None releases B and Up; flat holds B; lob holds B and Up. Each applied action holds for at least six frames.
The classifier uses three separate choice groups, all evaluated from this same observation:
Movement: A=neutral_release_a; B=neutral_hold_a; C=left_release_a; D=left_hold_a; E=right_release_a; F=right_hold_a.
Throw if facing left: G=none; H=flat; I=lob.
Throw if facing right: J=none; K=flat; L=lob.
Only the throw group for the selected movement's resulting facing is applied.

The current countdown and hops_left report that commitment. The tray-down opening lasts 72 updates. Contact with the living boss hurts during tray_down and flinch too. Defeat is harmless. Kittie's existing damage protection still applies. You can run beneath him when his feet clear your body. Flat arena; shutters at x160 and x320. Defeat opens the right shutter. World x points right, y down; player y is feet. Fresh A jumps on ground or in coyote time; hold for the full arc, release to shorten or rearm. Fresh B throws forward; Up+B lobs higher. Held A or B creates no new press.
